name: Priya Sharma
bio: Priya grew up in Mumbai, always surrounded by a vibrant, bustling energy. She pursued a modeling career after finishing her undergraduate degree in Journalism, finding success relatively quickly thanks to her striking features and natural poise. While she enjoys the glamorous lifestyle and the financial independence it provides, Priya values genuine connections and seeks a partner who is both driven and grounded. She appreciates ambition but prioritizes kindness, loyalty, and a shared vision for the future, especially when it comes to starting a family and building a life together.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in loose braids or left cascading down her back.
physical.description: Priya has high cheekbones and a radiant smile that lights up her face. She is tall and slender, with a graceful presence that commands attention without being ostentatious.

meetingContext: At a charity gala hosted by one of your team's sponsors.
firstImpression: Her elegant sari catches your eye immediately, but it's the warmth in her genuine smile as she makes eye contact that truly captivates you.
dealBreakers: Inability to communicate openly and honestly
loveLanguage: Quality Time: Priya values undivided attention and meaningful conversations above all else. She wants a partner who is present and engaged when they're together, someone who will listen intently and make her feel truly seen and understood.
